Repair this four-file project. Return ONLY JSON {"files":{...}} with exactly api.rs, client.rs; both complete replacement contents, no fences or explanation.
Maintain the two-file score API. saturating_sum(a:u32,b:u32)->u32 returns min(a+b,4294967295), with mathematical addition. entrypoint(a:u32,b:u32,c:u32)->u64 calls it once with original a,b and returns 7*provider_result+(c AND 7). Both current files need changes; no u32 carry may be discarded.
Each Rust file is a complete string with exactly one public function. Preserve use crate::api; in client.rs; no other imports, attributes, comments, strings, loops, closures, unsafe, globals, extra functions, foreign calls or extra paths. Only bool/u8/u16/u32/u64/usize and Vec<u8> types. Allowed primitive methods: wrapping_add,wrapping_sub,wrapping_mul,saturating_add,saturating_sub,saturating_mul,abs_diff,min,max,len,into. Only vec![byte;length], drop(value), and the one api provider call are allowed non-method calls. Array indexing and arithmetic/if expressions are allowed. No clone/resize or other methods. These are the complete finite profile restrictions, not examples.
Only these two files are editable in BOTH full and node interfaces. The other two remain unchanged.
Public cases [arguments,[entrypoint result,independent provider probe result]]:
[[[0,0,7],[7,0]],[[4294967295,1,4],[30064771069,4294967295]],[[13,29,5],[299,42]]]
Current context:
{"physical_files":{"api.rs":"pub fn saturating_sum(a:u32,b:u32)->u32 { a.wrapping_add(b) }","audit.rs":"pub fn audit_tag(c:u32)->u32 { c & 7 }","client.rs":"use crate::api; pub fn entrypoint(a:u32,b:u32,c:u32)->u64 { (api::saturating_sum(a,b) as u64)*7+(c&3) as u64 }","utility.rs":"pub fn utility(x:u32)->u32 { x & 255 }"}}
Both interfaces use the same finite ASCII Rust parser/profile: scalar/Vec<u8> declarations, arithmetic, method/call/index/cast expressions, simple let bindings, assignments, returns and if/block expressions. No Unicode, comments, attributes, strings, closures, custom macros or declarations. The sole allowed macro form is vec![byte;length]. Parser/AST depth <=64; source <=16384 ASCII bytes/file. Signatures are fixed except the declared API migration, which can change types while retaining parameter names and arity.
The into conversion method has a narrow additional rule: its receiver must be a bare identifier naming a declared scalar function parameter (u8/u16/u32/u64/usize/bool), with zero arguments. Macro definitions and dollar-sign metavariables are outside this profile in every file. In a file using into, do not shadow that receiver parameter, use closures or bar operators, or use complex let binding patterns. Container, field and expression receivers are outside this profile. Real rustc still decides whether the requested target conversion exists. Normal as casts remain available.
